messages.author: 0c03ef3e6934128f
messages.subject: need help loading workspace made before ggplot was deprecated
parts:
Having acquired ver. 2.10 of R, I find I cannot load my workspace
created under 2.9.2 because I'd had
library ggplot there. The fatal message in my load call: "There is no
package ggplot". Alas, there are LOTS of
files in that workspace that are no where else. Any suggestions?
(Seems there are no arguments for load
that would ignore a library. And nothing appears in my searches of
nabble to help.)
Thank you, bob p

messages.subject: Re: need help loading workspace made before ggplot was deprecated
parts:
Hi Bob,
I didn't mean to imply that it would be that easy. You need to
download the source packge and install it with R CMD INSTALL. And in
order for this to work at all you need certain tools installed on your
system -- see http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/RMacOSX-FAQ.html#Installation-of-source-packages
for instructions on how to install source packages on OS X.

Good luck!

-Ista
